Blind full fit (--fold -1 --ema) of the swin_supervised recipe, so the member sits in the same lane as the five blind members it would join. swinbase, backbone-lr 1e-4, train-size 384, slices 20, band 0.1-0.9, max pooling, batch 1 accumulate 6 - every flag held from swin_supervised.sh, only the fold and EMA change.

PRICE: swin_supervised converged at epoch 6 of 12 and declined after, so 8 epochs at ~370 s is ~50 min of a card that is otherwise idle. It cannot be priced offline by construction, so the read is a board slot, and this arm's job is to have the shippable form READY rather than to earn the slot itself. P(clears +0.002 on the board as a champion seat) ~ 0.15 - low because three board seat operations have already come back unresolvable, but it is the only one of them that changes the ARCHITECTURE rather than the seating, and the fold-0 evidence says the member is decorrelated rather than merely weak.

HOW IT IS READ. As deltas against the control entry on the board, never absolute (knee-nh3w). No holdout number exists for it - it is --fold -1 - so nothing may be entered in the ledger as its score.
close_reason: Killed 7 minutes in, before the lane's own arithmetic was checked against the board. The arm existed to have an architecture-distant member in shippable (blind) form. vjepaseat_v1 had ALREADY run that experiment on the board on 2026-08-30: raptorweight_v1's serving with one seat added, using vjepa_warm_s2026 at nearest-neighbour 0.8119 - MORE distant than swin_supervised's 0.8346 - and it read 0.943 against the control's 0.944. Flat. Its board row sizes what the lane needs: +0.017 to +0.020 solo over the lane's current 0.8331. A blind refit buys roughly 0.008, so this arm could not have reached the bar it was aimed at, and 2h of card would have bought a member pre-refuted by its own lane's measured requirement. Arm file deleted rather than parked - it is not a plan awaiting a card, it is a plan answered. Re-open the LANE, not this arm, with a non-DINO trunk at or above the seated quality level; that is a member-quality problem, not a fit problem. Card went to knee-8ft1 (stack_increments_ff) instead.

title: Cross distillation with the merged corpus: the two things that made the best two members, never combined
description:
stack_increments_s2026 is the best solo the project owns (0.8642) and the only member that distils from raptor_teacher.npz. merged_span_cf / merged_labelwise_cf are the merged-corpus members (0.8618 / 0.8587) and none of them distils. The two quality levers have never been in the same member.

knee-urvf is why this is the arm to run: the ensemble tracks best-single + ~0.015 and that bonus has not grown in fourteen days, so member quality is the only free term left. Two readings on 2026-08-31 closed the other half from both sides - stack_increments (best quality, ordinary diversity) priced +0.0002 as a seat and merged_labelwise_cf (most decode-diverse candidate ever priced, nearest 0.8873 / mean 0.8583) priced +0.0005. Neither half buys a seat alone, so the seat is not the lever and the member is.

ONE VARIABLE against stack_increments: the corpus, blend_three_v1.csv -> merged_blend_v1.csv. Distillation weight 0.3, raptor teacher, --hold-annotations, --calibrated-targets, band 0.1-0.9, slices 20, pooling max, backbone-lr 4e-5, 12 epochs, eval ruler report_labels_v2.csv all held. So it is a matched read of what the merged corpus does to a DISTILLED member, which neither parent can answer.

--hold-annotations is carried, not introduced: it is stack_increments' own flag and dropping it would make the read two-variable. knee-9198 bans retraining the ROSTER under it, not carrying it in one matched arm.

THE EXPECTED COLLISION, stated before the number. merged_dense_cf showed the merged corpus SUBSTITUTES for a denser read (-0.0028 against merged_blend_cf), and merged_labelwise_cf repeated it on the pooling axis (0.8587 against its 0.8618 parent). A distillation teacher is a better-labelled signal by the same argument, so a third collision is the live branch.

PRICE: 12 epochs at ~430 s = ~86 min of a card that is otherwise idle. It needs 0.8704 (stack_increments 0.8642 + the 0.0062 paired floor) to be a real quality gain. P(clears 0.8704) ~ 0.2 - the two prior collisions are the reason it is not higher, and the fact that no member has ever held both levers is the reason it is not lower. 86 min at 0.2 on the ONLY free term beats an idle card and beats a fourth seat permutation, which the same day priced at zero twice.

HOW IT IS READ. Control stack_increments = 0.8642.
  * >= 0.8704: the levers are independent, the merged corpus does not eat a teacher, and the quality lane reopens.
  * 0.8580 to 0.8703: within the floor. Not a verdict; keep only if seat_value picks it over the roster.
  * <= 0.8579: THIRD collision, and that promotes 'the merged corpus substitutes for any finer signal' from an observation to a property of the corpus. Then the corpus lane is one cell wide and the next lever is a genuinely different external corpus (MRNet, knee-ombx), not another cross.
notes:
BAND RESTATED AS DELTAS against the control, per knee-nh3w - the original description names absolute scores, which is the defect that bead files. Control is stack_increments_s2026 on the same fold-0 holdout and the same report_labels_v2 ruler.

  * delta >= +0.0062: the levers are independent, the merged corpus does not eat a teacher, quality lane reopens.
  * -0.0062 < delta < +0.0062: inside the paired floor. Not a verdict; keep only if seat_value picks it.
  * delta <= -0.0062: THIRD collision, corpus lane is one cell wide, next lever is MRNet (knee-ombx).

PRICE: ~86 min on an otherwise-idle card. P(clears +0.0062) ~ 0.2.

title: Pre-registration bands must be drawn by SUBTRACTING the control, never by naming absolute scores
description:
Second occurrence. holdswap_v1's kernel wrote its bands against 'the champion's 0.944' in prose and anchored the arithmetic at 0.941: the 'real gain over the champion, above the resolution floor' band opens at 0.9425, BELOW the champion, and the FLAT band sits lower still. The entry scored 0.944 - arithmetically identical to the control - and landed numerically inside a band labelled 'a real gain'.

comp/champion.json already records the first occurrence, for raptorweight_v1: its 'real gain' edge of 0.9435 was not an attainable score at all, because the board quantises to 0.001.

Both were caught only by subtracting the control by hand after the fact. A band written as an absolute score carries an anchor that can silently be the previous champion, a remembered number, or a score the board cannot express.

FIX: a pre-registration states a DELTA against a named control plus the control's ref, and the absolute edges are computed from the control at read time. A band edge that is not a multiple of 0.001 away from the control is a bug, because the board cannot return it.

Candidate home: a check that reads a kernel's band block and the control's row from comp/board.jsonl and refuses edges that are unattainable or that sit on the wrong side of the control.

title: The fold-0 proxy ruler for BLIND champion seats -- built 2026-08-30, tested by holdswap_v1
description:
THE PROBLEM IT SOLVES. comp/champion.json pins an entry whose six members are all --fold -1. None carries a holdout record, so no seat of the best entry this project owns can be priced offline, and every seat change has had to be bought with a submission slot. That is why the champion's history is a chain of board-fitted swaps.

THE CONSTRUCTION. Five of the champion's six have fold-0 analogues that DO carry holdout records: calib_span_s2026, grade_ladder_s2026, merged_blend_s2026, lr4e-5_ws_s2026, through_dense_s2026. There is no fold-0 final_ws, so the sixth seat is outside the instrument and always will be unless one is trained. Hold those five as a roster in record_mix --roster and price candidates against them; curve.swap then names which analogue each candidate would displace.

WHAT IT READ (logs/swap_champion_proxy.log, 909 shared studies, LogitAverage, roster of 5 = 0.8697). Ten strong pool members priced. TEN OF TEN named the same incumbent to displace: lr4e-5_ws, the weakest of the five at 0.8525 solo. Five of the ten cleared BOARD_RESOLVABLE = +0.0015 on that swap (labelwise_dense +0.0024, stack_increments +0.0021, finding_calib_dense +0.0019, calib_dense_hold +0.0018, merged_span_cf +0.0018). An independent earlier run had already recorded the same seat on the roster line for finding_calib_dense: '+0.0017 as a swap for lr4e-5_ws on the champion shadow'. So the sign reproduces across two runs.

WHY THE ORDERING IS NOT USED. knee-7d1 measured that only the SIGN of a member swap transfers; the ordering broke on its third point. So the table names a SEAT, not an entrant. The entrant for holdswap_v1 was picked by two independent constraints instead: BLIND (greedyseat paid 0.936 against the champion's 0.944 for shipping fold-0 members) and inside the group the proxy could not separate. calib_dense_hold_ff was the only member satisfying both.

WHAT holdswap_v1 (ref 55900461) TESTS. Whether this proxy ORDERS blind seats at all. Its pre-registration is in the kernel docstring with four disjoint bands against the champion's 0.944. A gain says the remaining five champion seats can be ranked offline without a slot each -- which would be worth far more than the tick itself. A flat says the proxy separates members the board cannot separate, and the champion six are interchangeable at this quality level.

THE STANDING LIMITS. The proxy is fold-0 and every entry it advises is blind; the sixth seat was never in the comparison; and it prices over 909 shared studies of OUR corpus while the board's test set is hidden and not ours.
notes: PRICE (2026-08-30T22:55Z, for merged_span_ff.sh and labelwise_dense_ff.sh). COST: ~45 min card each, ~90 min for both, on a card that is otherwise IDLE overnight and cannot be spent on anything competing -- cnx_warm_anneal finishes ~23:15Z and the single overnight submission slot does not open until 00:00 UTC. Opportunity cost is therefore near zero in wall-clock terms; the real cost is that neither arm can be priced offline by construction (--fold -1 has seen every holdout study). GAIN: the second champion seat is UNREACHABLE without one of them -- the step-2 swap table names four candidates and there is no blind full-fit of any of them on disk, and shipping a fold-0 member onto a champion-shaped entry is what greedyseat already paid 0.936-vs-0.944 for. Offline the swap prices at +0.0017 (merged_span_cf) and +0.0021 (labelwise_dense), both above BOARD_RESOLVABLE = 0.0015 and both inside the 0.0062 unseparable band, so the table gives the SIGN and not the ordering. P(clears +0.0015 on the board) ~= 0.30, and it is CONDITIONAL: holdswap_v1's bands A/B (>= 0.9425) keep this axis open, bands C/D close it and no further slot goes to a single-seat swap. RATIO: 90 min of free card for a ~30% shot at the one axis that has twice moved this champion (res392_ws -> band_dense, 0.925 -> 0.928; and holdswap now), plus, at worst, two blind members of greedy seats two and three that any whole-corpus roster can use. Taken as a HEDGE armed before the band is known, deliberately, the same trade calib_dense_hold_ff took against fourseat_v1.

title: mount_check --live crashes on model_sources: it queries metaresearch/dinov2 as a DATASET
description:
On 2026-08-30, before the holdswap_v1 submission, 'python -m kneemri.kaggle.mount_check --live' died with CalledProcessError on ['kaggle.exe','datasets','files','metaresearch/dinov2','--csv','--page-size','1000'] (exit 1). metaresearch/dinov2 is a MODEL source, not a dataset, so 'kaggle datasets files' cannot resolve it. The crash is in EncoderMounts.over (mount_check.py:240) -> LiveDataset.holds (live_dataset.py:130) -> paths() -> _cli (live_dataset.py:62).

This is not specific to one kernel: every kernel in the repo declares metaresearch/dinov2 model_sources, so --live is dead for ALL of them. The offline mount_check still passes and covers the identity question (69 ok, 5 skipped, 0 refused of 74). The LIVE question it was written for -- does the mounted dataset actually hold the checkpoints the kernel names -- had to be answered by hand for holdswap: 'kaggle datasets files dimiturnt/kneemri-members --csv --page-size 1000' listed all six members including calib_dense_hold_ff.pt. That worked because the members MOUNT is a real dataset; only the model_sources entries are not.

The check must split its sources: dataset_sources go to 'kaggle datasets files', model_sources go to the models API (or are skipped with a stated reason). Today's workaround silently loses the encoder-mount half of the check, which is the half that caught the DINOv3/DINOv2 metadata mismatch this tool exists for.

title: Is v3's +0.0105 the re-map or the 224 corner? One dense-corner replication separates them
description:
FOLLOW-UP (2) of knee-8wa0, named in the ledger's own cost order: v3 is free (done), THEN a dense-corner
replication, and only THEN a roster rebuild.

WHAT LANDED. recal_holdannot swapped holdannot's supervision table for report_labels_v3.csv, whose six
reader levels are replaced by their measured positive rates on the 58 radiologist-read studies. Read on
both rulers per knee-9198, gold first:

  ruler                                     holdannot   recal_holdannot   delta
  GOLD (supervision_gap, 58 studies)          0.8932        0.9037        +0.0105
  proxy (ruler_check on v2, 909 studies)      0.8506        0.8515        +0.0009
  proxy, confident-only (71.0% of cells)      0.8740        0.8754        +0.0014

Gold up past the 0.0062 floor, proxy not down: the arm's LANDS branch.

THE OPEN QUESTION. n=58 is a level and not a selector (knee-kddo), and one arm at one recipe corner
(224 px, 12 slices, band 0.2-0.8) cannot separate the RE-MAP from the CORNER. This arm is the cheapest
possible separation: band_dense_hold already exists as a matched control read on BOTH rulers, so the
comparison costs nothing beyond the one 40-minute run.

PRICE: ~40 min of card. P(clears the 0.0062 gold floor) ~ 0.5 -- a replication of a single n=58 read at a
different corner, with the corner itself the named suspect. Priced as an INSTRUMENT: it produces no
seatable member (a table swap is not a quality lever, and the control is 0.8573 proxy). What it buys is
whether follow-up (3), the roster rebuild, may ever be armed -- which is many arms and is licensed by
nothing today.

PRE-REGISTERED on gold first:
  REPLICATES -- gold up 0.0062+ over band_dense_hold's gold, proxy not down by the floor. The re-map is a
    property of the table, not the corner. Licenses follow-up (3).
  CORNER -- gold within 0.0062 either way. The +0.0105 was the 224 corner. v3 stays the default table
    (free) and the label lane stops being priced as a member lane.
  REFUTES -- gold down 0.0062 or more. At the dense corner the re-map moves training away from the
    image-read process; the follow-up goes per-finding rather than pooled.

--eval-labels IS PINNED TO v2, and that is the lesson of the arm above rather than a preference.
recal_holdannot passed --labels v3 with --eval-labels unset, so its holdout truth was binarised at 0.5
against the RE-MAPPED values: the ruler moved with the arm and the log ended "best holdout mean AUC
0.8964", +0.0477 over its control, which sat there for an hour looking like the largest single-arm gain
this project has ever measured. run_comparison refuses the pair outright. Any label-VALUE arm pins the
eval table.

Arm: experiments/arms/recal_band_dense.sh
notes:
DUPLICATE. recal_dense (experiments/arms/recal_dense.sh, on the card since 19:08 UTC, epoch 2 of 12,
reports ~20:30 UTC) IS this arm. Byte-identical invocation:

  $RECIPE --epochs 12 --slice-pooling max --whole-stack $THROUGHPUT
  --backbone-lr 4e-5 --slices 20 --band-low 0.1 --band-high 0.9 --hold-annotations
  --labels report_labels_v3.csv --eval-labels report_labels_v2.csv

Same control (band_dense_hold, 0.8573 proxy), same single variable, and --eval-labels already pinned to
v2, so the recal_holdannot ruler defect does not repeat. Follow-up (2) was armed before I wrote it.

I wrote experiments/arms/recal_band_dense.sh, arm_check-ed it, committed it (327165a) and queued it
behind cnx_warm_anneal before noticing. Watcher killed, arm deleted, queue_check and card_check green.
Nothing reached the card: the duplicate would have run at ~21:50 UTC for 40 minutes, and the cost would
have been the READING as much as the card -- two runs of one recipe under two names, either of which a
later session could have quoted as a replication of the other.

The audit failure is exact and worth keeping. I knew "recal_dense is running now" -- it is in the card
queue line of every status I wrote this window -- and I never opened the arm to ask WHAT it was. I read
recal_holdannot.sh and band_dense_hold.sh to build the invocation, and the file that already held that
invocation was the one job on the GPU. CLAUDE.md's order is audit -> file -> plan -> work, and the audit
step is "read the actual files, not greps about them"; a running arm is part of the tree to audit, not
just a resource to wait on. Cheapest guard: before writing an arm, diff its intended invocation against
every *.running.sh in the experiments dir, which is exactly the set of things the card is doing.

The pre-registration in the deleted file was not wasted -- it is the branch table in this bead's
description, and it applies to recal_dense unchanged. Read that run on BOTH rulers, gold first, and
never from its training log.

Superseded by the run itself. Re-open only if recal_dense dies before it converges.

title: Seating saturation survives the 93-member roster: 11 new candidates, all negative, best -0.0002
description:
MEASURED 2026-08-30 19:07Z, CPU only (cached holdout predictions), no card and no slot.

Every seat scan before today was made against a pool that was missing members: roster_check's 2026-08-29
sweep found 76 scoreable checkpoints in neither the roster nor anywhere else, thirty of which joined. The
roster now holds 93. The obvious objection to "the ensemble axis is saturated" (knee-va22, knee-xuj5,
knee-urvf) was therefore that it had been read off an under-supplied pool.

Tested. seat_value --against greedyseat_v1 over the eleven strongest new members with cached predictions:

  candidate                solo      seat value   nearest-neighbour
  attend_dense_s2026       0.8569    -0.0002      0.8814  (most distant)
  raptor_distill_s2026     0.8613    -0.0003      0.9134
  blendlabels_s2026        0.8537    -0.0003      0.9220
  distill_pairs_s2026      0.8594    -0.0004      0.9079
  stackfit_s2026           0.8631    -0.0004      0.9384  (nearest twin)
  depth_regions_s2026      0.8549    -0.0006      0.8880
  merged_corpus_s2026      0.8545    -0.0006      0.9079
  mixup_dense_s2026        0.8552    -0.0007      0.8948
  ema_dense_s2026          0.8588    -0.0007      0.9124
  band_dense_hold_s2026    0.8573    -0.0007      0.9063
  band_density_s2026       0.8540    -0.0009      0.9107

All eleven negative. Zero of eleven clear +0.0015, the threshold under which this ruler has never been
shown to pick a board tick, and no candidate's interval excludes zero. The tool's own verdict line: "no
candidate's band excludes zero over 11 priced - this pool adds nothing readable". Best possible swap is
-0.0002 (attend_dense or raptor_distill, both for calib_dense_hold), which the board charges at about 3x
(knee-c0u9), so roughly -0.0005 - not a free look.

WHY IT IS A FINDING AND NOT ELEVEN BAD DRAWS. The distance column. stackfit is the strongest solo of the
eleven and the MOST redundant at 0.9384 nearest-neighbour; the most distant candidate, attend_dense at
0.8814, is still far from the 0.8346 swin_supervised reaches and still prices negative. Thirty new members
and every one of them is the same lens - which is what the architecture-monoculture principle in
comp/champion.json predicts, now measured on the enlarged pool rather than the old one.

CONSEQUENCE. "The pool was under-supplied" is refused. The saturation survives a 5x larger candidate set
than the one it was originally read off, so knee-va22 / knee-xuj5 / knee-urvf are strengthened rather than
re-opened, and no slot should go to a reseating of what we hold. Combined with knee-orjq (stacking closed,
7/7) and the board-density arithmetic (interpretations/kneemri/2026-08-30_one-board-tick-is-fourteen-places.md,
+0.003 = rank 6), the only surviving routes are a genuinely new mechanism on one member, a non-DINO trunk
good enough to seat, or external data.

WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY. One roster (greedyseat_v1's seven), one ruler, one instant. It does not price the
twelfth new member (stack_increments_s2026, 0.8642, the project best solo) because it has no cached
prediction; that one costs a card pass and should be added when the card is next free, since it is the only
new member whose solo exceeds the seated best.

title: Non-DINO lane inherits --unfreeze-last as a COUNT, not a fraction
description:
Every run this project has done on a non-DINOv2 trunk -- nine of them, smokes excluded -- shares one recipe skeleton transplanted from DINOv2-small: one_cycle True, layer_decay 1.0/None, unfreeze_last 6, head_lr 1e-3, patience 0, ema False. Three of the nine never converged (cnx_dense climbing at e11, vit_in21k 5 of 12 epochs climbing, vjepa_member climbing at e10), so vjepa2l 0.8343 and vitin21k 0.7847 are FLOORS quoted in this repo as those trunks' worth.

Four candidate explanations for the non-DINO deficit -- architecture, pretraining, rate, schedule -- and the project has been quoting the first while only ever testing under one setting of the other three.

THE MECHANISM, SHARPENED. The flag that does the damage is --unfreeze-last, because it is a COUNT fitted on a 12-block trunk. Read off Encoder.blocks (the real depth for a hierarchical trunk -- cnxbase states depth 12 and runs 36):

  dinov2-small  12 blocks   6 opens 50%   0.8964
  vitin21k      12 blocks   6 opens 50%   0.7847 (floor, 5 of 12 epochs)
  swinbase      24 blocks   6 opens 25%   0.8331
  vjepa2l       24 blocks   6 opens 25%   0.8343 (floor, still climbing)
  cnxbase       36 blocks   6 opens 17%   0.8186

Among the converged runs the ordering is monotone in opened fraction. Confounded with architecture and NOT offered as the explanation -- it is why this is the cheapest of the four explanations to eliminate. A block's job is set by where it sits in the trunk, not by its index from the end: the last six of a 12-block ViT are its whole second half, the last six of a 36-block ConvNeXt are the tail of one stage.

THE ARM: experiments/arms/swin_open_half.sh. Match the FRACTION rather than the count -- --unfreeze-last 12 on swinbase's 24, with --layer-decay 0.7 (the value band_dense_llrd measured) travelling with it, because opening twice as many blocks at one flat rate is how a deeper opening goes wrong. The pair is ONE mechanism. Rate held at the control's 1e-4 so the arm stays matched to swin_supervised in every other respect.

PRICE: ~2.5-3 h of card. Control swin_supervised ran 12 epochs at 384 px with six open blocks in ~90 min; twelve open blocks doubles what must be retained for the backward and the twelve include stage three at stride 16. P(clears the +0.017-0.020 seat bar over swin_supervised's 0.8331) ~= 0.15. Priced as an IMPROVEMENT this is a ~0-expected-score run.

IT IS ARMED AS AN INSTRUMENT AND MUST BE JUDGED AS ONE. What it buys is licence to re-read the lane: nine runs and three quoted floors rest on the assumption that a DINOv2 recipe transfers. P(it moves the number at all, either way, by more than 0.010) ~= 0.5, and EITHER SIGN is informative -- REFUTES closes the recipe explanation and sends the lane to knee-8009 with one arm instead of four.

Schedule (one_cycle on/off) is NOT moved by this arm. It is binary in this trainer, dropping it contradicts a measured DINOv2 result (schedule_8, -0.0028) and it would add a fourth variable to an arm already answering a joint question. It stays open as the follow-up if this one comes back FLAT.

BLOCKED ON cnx_warm_anneal, the lane's matched control.
notes:
PRICE (knee-qxse). Arm experiments/arms/swin_open_half.sh.

COST: ~2.5-3 h of card. Control swin_supervised ran 12 epochs at 384 px with six open blocks in ~90 min; twelve open blocks doubles what must be retained for the backward and the twelve include stage three at stride 16.

GAIN: the seat bar is +0.017 to +0.020 solo over 0.8331 (see interpretations/kneemri/2026-08-30_the-non-dino-lane-is-quality-bound.md). P(one recipe flag pair delivers that) is LOW -- call it 0.15. Priced as an IMPROVEMENT this is a ~0-expected-score run.

IT IS ARMED AS AN INSTRUMENT AND MUST BE JUDGED AS ONE. What it buys is the licence to re-read the lane: nine runs and three quoted floors (vjepa2l 0.8343, vitin21k 0.7847, cnx_dense 0.7927) currently rest on the assumption that a DINOv2 recipe transfers. P(it moves the number at all, either way, by more than 0.010) is roughly 0.5, and EITHER SIGN is informative -- REFUTES closes the recipe explanation and sends the lane to knee-8009 with one arm instead of four.

THE MECHANISM SHARPENED SINCE THIS BEAD WAS FILED. The flag that does the damage is --unfreeze-last, and the reason is that it is a COUNT fitted on a 12-block trunk. Read off Encoder.blocks (the real depth for a hierarchical trunk -- cnxbase states depth 12 and runs 36):

  dinov2-small  12 blocks   6 opens 50%   0.8964
  vitin21k      12 blocks   6 opens 50%   0.7847 (floor, 5 of 12 epochs)
  swinbase      24 blocks   6 opens 25%   0.8331
  vjepa2l       24 blocks   6 opens 25%   0.8343 (floor, still climbing)
  cnxbase       36 blocks   6 opens 17%   0.8186

Among the converged runs the ordering is monotone in opened fraction. Confounded with architecture and NOT offered as the explanation -- it is why this is the cheapest of the four explanations to eliminate.

So the arm matches the FRACTION rather than the count: --unfreeze-last 12 on swinbase's 24, with --layer-decay 0.7 (the value band_dense_llrd measured) travelling with it, because opening twice as many blocks at one flat rate is how a deeper opening goes wrong. The pair is ONE mechanism. Rate held at the control's 1e-4 so the arm stays matched to swin_supervised in every other respect.

Schedule (one_cycle on/off) is NOT moved. It is binary in this trainer, dropping it contradicts a measured DINOv2 result (schedule_8, -0.0028) and it would add a fourth variable to an arm that is already answering a joint question. It stays open as the follow-up if this one comes back FLAT.

title: queue_check: false DOUBLE-QUEUED - the launching shell is not the watcher's parent on the Windows probe
description:
FIXED 2026-08-30 in the same sitting it was found; this bead is the record, because the shape recurs.

WHAT HAPPENED. queue_check exited 2 with "DOUBLE-QUEUED: experiments/arms/recal_dense.sh" against a queue that was correct: swin_calib_dense -> recal_dense -> (warm_calib_lowlr, cnx_warm_anneal), three live watchers, exactly one owing recal_dense. Acting on the verdict as printed means killing a healthy chain and losing the card's evening.

WHY IT FIRED. doubled() counts process-table lines whose argv CONTAINS the arm path. Two live lines carried experiments/arms/recal_dense.sh: the real after.sh watcher, and the harness shell that launched it, whose own -c string embeds the whole `nohup bash experiments/after.sh ... & disown` command.

WHY THE EXISTING GUARD MISSED IT, which is the part worth keeping. watchers() already dropped the launcher, by PARENTAGE - "dropping any line that is the PARENT of another watcher line removes exactly that wrapper". That invariant holds on the POSIX probe and is FALSE on the Windows one: nohup + disown under MSYS re-parents through an intermediate, so the launcher read pid 30016 while the watcher it started read a parent of 37388. The launcher is not the watcher's parent there, nothing was dropped, and the unit test covering the drop had fixed the wrapper AS the parent - encoding the one arrangement the real failure never has. A test can hold a false invariant still.

A SECOND IMPOSTOR, found in the same dump and unrelated to parentage. Any process whose argv merely mentions after.sh matched - a grep, an editor, a checker, including the probe used to diagnose this. Those lines have no pid columns, so parentage reads blank and the drop could never have removed them either. Today they only inflated counts for arms named in their own argv; a `grep after.sh experiments/arms/recal_dense.sh` fabricates a blocking DOUBLE-QUEUED on its own.

THE FIX. A watcher is now identified by WHERE the token sits, not by whose child the process is: a shell running a -c string is a launcher and never a watcher whatever it embeds, and in a real invocation the script is the token immediately after the interpreter - the one arrangement both probe formats share. The parentage drop is kept as a second line of defence for the POSIX probe. Two tests added for the shapes that actually occur: a launcher that is NOT the parent, and an onlooker with no pids at all.

THE GENERAL LESSON, and why this is filed rather than just fixed. This is the SECOND false blocking verdict from this one check (2026-08-21 was the first). A guard that cries wolf is worse than no guard: CLAUDE.md requires queue_check at every session end and every watcher launch, so a standing false positive trains the reader to skip a check that is also the only thing standing between two watchers and one card. Every other check in this project that crosses the process table shares the exposure - card_check and misarmed() both reason over the same listing - and the Windows/POSIX parentage difference is a property of the PROBE, not of this check.

title: Feature distillation as PRETRAINING: the domain adaptation every non-DINO trunk in this project never got
description:
OWNER, 2026-08-30: 'distill is good for pretraining too if we decide we want this order.' Correct, and it is a different mechanism from what knee-for6 and knee-7ybf price - those add a teacher term to a LABELLED fine-tune. This is a pretraining STAGE before labels.

WHAT IS BUILT AND WHAT IS NOT. DistilledObjective is ADDITIVE (objective.py:398): loss = ranked_label_loss + distill_weight * imitation(batch). Labels never switch off, so there is no teacher-only mode; a large weight only makes the teacher dominant. More important, imitation() reuses the PAIR machinery - the student's logits judged against the teacher's SCORES, over the corpus's twelve targets. That is ORDERING distillation. It is a sound fine-tune term and a THIN pretraining signal: twelve output dimensions over 4,406 studies cannot shape a trunk's representation.

THE REFRAME THIS OPENS, and it is the reason to take the bead seriously. The architecture-monoculture reading records best-per-trunk as small 0.8964 vs cnxbase 0.8186, swinbase 0.8331, vjepa2l 0.8343 - and has been read as an ARCHITECTURE result. But the DINOv2 trunks arrive carrying large-scale self-supervised pretraining, and every non-DINO trunk here arrives with ImageNet weights and nothing else. The two groups differ in PRETRAINING as much as in block layout, and this project has never once separated those terms. Feature distillation on knee MRI is exactly the domain pretraining the CNN/Swin trunks never had, which makes 'non-DINO trunks are worse' a hypothesis with an untested confound rather than a finding.

THE REAL BUILD (b), which is what could plausibly move 1.5%: match the teacher's EMBEDDING, not its twelve scores. Student trunk trained to reproduce teacher features under cosine/MSE, then fitted_encoder exports the trunk and a normal labelled run warm-starts from it - the order the owner named. Signal dimension goes from 12 to the teacher's embedding width, and the objective needs NO LABELS, which is the part that matters most: it can consume studies the label table does not cover. comp/champion.json's last principle says the member-quality lane ceilings near 0.943 and 'the remaining routes are external data and stacking'. Label-free feature distillation IS the external-data route, expressed as a member we can seat.

WHAT IT COSTS. TeacherFile stores scores as n x t and would need an n x d embedding array (a sibling writer beside TeacherFile.write, same two-names-in-one-place contract). A feature-matching objective beside DistilledObjective. A pretrain entrypoint or a train flag that runs the feature loss alone. Estimate half a day of code, then ~40 min teacher embedding pass (once, reused free) and ~30-50 min per student pretrain, plus the labelled fine-tune which warm start makes ~20 min. ZERO submission slots.

THE CHEAP VERSION (a), buildable TODAY with zero new code, and its purpose is to decide whether (b) is worth building: run the existing distill arm at a large --distill-weight (10-30 rather than the 0.3 both prior arms held), export the trunk with fitted_encoder, then warm-start a normal labelled run from it. That is the owner's ORDER using only parts in the tree. It is NOT the real mechanism - the signal is still twelve-dimensional - so it is an INSTRUMENT: if a teacher-dominant first stage moves the warm fine-tune at all, the representation channel is live and (b) is licensed; if it is flat, (b) is still not refuted because ordering-over-12 was always the wrong signal for pretraining, and that must be said in advance rather than after the number.

PRICE. (a): ~50 min stage one plus ~20 min warm fine-tune, 0 slots. P(clears the 0.0062 floor) ~ 0.20. Bought as an instrument, not an improvement. (b): half a day of code plus ~1.5 h card. P(clears the 1.5% house bar) ~ 0.15 - the highest this project has priced any single unrun mechanism, because it is the only one that both removes a named confound and opens the external-data route. P(clears the 0.0062 floor) ~ 0.5.

WHAT NO OUTCOME LICENSES. Neither version says anything about the ARCHITECTURE comparison until a non-DINO trunk gets the pretraining and is re-measured - that is the whole point of the bead, and quoting the monoculture table as an architecture result before then repeats the confound. And a warm-started student is correlated with its parent by construction (knee-wbwq); seat claims need record_mix, never the solo number.

DEPENDS ON: knee-7ybf (non-DINO student, fine-tune-stage distillation) and cnx_warm_anneal, which together establish whether the non-DINO trunk responds to a teacher at all before code is written for (b).
notes:
2026-08-31 (a) READ AND CLOSED, (b) UNTOUCHED.

swin_distill_pre (weight 20, raptor logits, 4 epochs) -> 0.8177. swin_distill_fit (warm from it, labels only, 12 epochs) -> 0.8255 against cold swin_supervised 0.8331. MEAN -0.0077, three starred negatives, zero starred positives.

The <=-0.0062 SUSPECT-THE-HARNESS branch fired and came back clean on every check it named: stage one recorded distill_weight 20.0 + non-null teacher_targets; stage two recorded a non-null encoder_weights with distill_weight 0.0 and teacher_targets None; arm_read's own diff is ONE flag (encoder_weights None->path); the export wrote 423 tensors from the 0.8177 checkpoint.

So: a trunk driven to imitate a teacher's twelve OUTPUT LOGITS is a worse initialisation than the pretrained trunk it started from. The target is head-level, so the trunk is shaped by another model's decision boundary and the fit pays to climb out of it.

(b) feature/representation distillation, label-free, is NOT refuted by this and that was written down before the run. Different target, different arm.

Caveat kept: stage one is UNDERTRAINED (4 epochs, still rising). A longer stage one changes the SIZE of this number, not its sign - it would still be a logit-shaped trunk.

interpretations/kneemri/2026-08-31_distilling_logits_is_not_pretraining.md
close_reason: raptor_feat_pre (0.8201) -> raptor_feat_fit (0.8334) reads +0.0003 against its pre-registered cold control swin_supervised_s2026 at 0.8331 — the FLAT branch, a twentieth of the 0.0062 floor. Cell (b), embedding-matched pretraining, is the build this bead asked for and it is measured. Both cells spent: (a) logit-level distillation lost 0.0077, (b) feature-level ties, so the -0.0077 measured the LEVEL of the target, not distillation as a mechanism. The confound this bead named — non-DINO trunks differ in PRETRAINING as much as in block layout — is answered in the direction that keeps the architecture reading: giving swinbase the domain pretraining it never had moved it 0.0003. The CORPUS cause (knee-ombx, MRNet) stays open. Ledger: experiments/README.md (2026-09-01).

title: Distil onto a NON-DINO student: knee-for6 closed on three causes and varied none of them
description:
OWNER ASKED, 2026-08-30: 'did we explore and exploit the idea for distillation training from our best ensemble to a new model? maybe as additional loss, even, possibly.' The additional-loss half is BUILT (--distill-weight / --teacher-targets) and the ensemble-teacher half is RUN. This bead is the cell neither arm touched.

WHAT IS ALREADY MEASURED, so no part of this is a rerun.
  distill_pairs   teacher = our own pool (an ensemble), student = DINOv2 dense   +0.0016, seat value -0.0003
  raptor_distill  teacher = raptor_v4_swa (foreign, board 0.923), student = DINOv2 dense   0.8613 vs band_dense 0.8578, +0.0035
  stack_increments  distillation + label-table swap   additive prediction 0.8703, measured 0.8642 - SUB-ADDITIVE
Both deltas sit inside the 0.0062 paired floor. Their ORDERING is the mechanism's own prediction holding: a teacher outside the family transfers more than a teacher inside it (+0.0035 > +0.0016). So the ensemble-as-teacher the owner asked about is the WEAKER of the two already-tried teachers, and the ledger names why - 'a rank average cannot pay for an ordering it already holds'.

THE OPENING. knee-for6 closed with: 'A student trained on our DECODE, our CORPUS and our TRUNK lands back in our pixel group whatever ordering it was taught - distillation moves ORDERING, the seat ruler prices PIXEL GROUP.' That is three named causes, and both distillation arms held all three FIXED at DINOv2-dense. The closure is an argument, not a measurement. Varying TRUNK is the cheapest of the three to vary and it is the one this project already has warm encoders for.

WHY THIS IS NOT SOLD AS A QUALITY ARM. Priced honestly: two distillation arms read +0.0016 and +0.0035 and nothing licenses expecting more from a third. The case is SEAT DISTANCE, which is the quantity knee-for6 actually declined on and the axis knee-nas5 measures transferring at ~2.4x the board slope. A cnxbase/swinbase student is a different pixel group BY CONSTRUCTION (448px convolutional trunk vs 224px ViT), which is the exact term the close reason blamed and never moved. A distant member that is merely level can still seat; a near member that is better cannot.

THE HONEST COUNTER, stated because it cuts against the bead: cnx solo is 0.8186 and swin is tracking ~0.822, both far under the 0.8460 roster merit level. A weak member seats rarely whatever its distance, and stack_increments already showed distillation competing for headroom rather than adding to it. If cnx_warm_anneal (queued) does not lift the trunk, this arm inherits a weak student and its distance claim gets priced against a member nobody would seat.

BUILD: nothing new. --distill-weight 0.3 held (not re-derived - sweeping a weight before a teacher is shown to transfer confounds two questions, the reason distill_v3base and raptor_distill both held it), --teacher-targets raptor_teacher.npz already on disk, student warm-started from encoders/cnx_own_recipe.enc.pt which fitted_encoder already wrote (378 tensors, variant cnxbase). Warm start makes it 6 epochs not 12.

PRICE: ~20 min of card warm (vs ~50 cold), 0 submission slots, teacher pass free. P(clears the 0.0062 holdout floor) ~ 0.30. P(clears the house 1.5% bar) ~ 0.03 - no single arm in 110 has. P(earns a seat on DISTANCE via record_mix) ~ 0.25, and that is the number this arm is actually bought for.

SEQUENCING: this runs AFTER cnx_warm_anneal, never instead of it. cnx_warm_anneal is the matched no-teacher control at the identical warm recipe, so running it first makes this arm single-variable and costs a control nothing.

SECOND CELL, NOT ARMED HERE: a teacher built from the CHAMPION ENSEMBLE (~0.943 board) rather than raptor solo (0.923) - strictly the strongest teacher available and it CONTAINS foreign members, so it carries quality and foreign ordering together. Costs a fresh ~40 min inference pass to write the npz. Not licensed until the non-DINO student shows the trunk term matters, because otherwise it varies teacher strength while the refuted term stays fixed.
notes:
2026-08-30 20:03 UTC — the arm is WRITTEN and not armed: experiments/arms/cnx_distill_warm.sh (commit d13bad98). It is cnx_warm_anneal's flag line plus --distill-weight 0.3 --teacher-targets raptor_teacher.npz and nothing else, so the control costs no card and mismatched can check the single-variable claim mechanically. arm_check: 0 refused (one OVERSTATED vram advisory inherited from the parent, which is measured rather than predicted — see cnx_own_recipe).

Pre-registration is written against cnx_warm_anneal's peak WHATEVER IT READS, deliberately, because that arm has not run yet. Four branches: trunk-term-real (>= +0.0062 AND positive record_mix seat value, which licenses the champion-ensemble teacher as the next arm), distant-but-flat (inside the floor with below-median NN distance — keep if free, no second cnx distill arm), neither (inside the floor and near the pool anyway — closes the pixel-group story and points at knee-8009), and harness-first (<= -0.0062 — verify distill_weight/teacher_targets landed and that the npz joins on THIS fold's train studies before believing it).

Still blocked on cnx_warm_anneal. Card: recal_dense at e6 0.8610 (~20:40 UTC), then warm_calib_lowlr, then cnx_warm_anneal.
close_reason: Answered by the swinbase student arms, which ARE this cell: a NON-DINO student taking a teacher term. Logit arms read +0.0016 and +0.0035 against the cold control swin_supervised_s2026 (0.8331); the feature arm raptor_feat_fit read 0.8334, +0.0003. Three teacher variants onto the non-DINO student, all inside the 0.0062 floor, one with an in-sample teacher that could only have flattered it. The cause this bead isolated — that knee-for6's null might be the STUDENT rather than distillation — does not hold. Closed with --force: the blocker knee-wbwq is the warm-start machinery, and these arms exercised it end to end (raptor_feat_fit loaded raptor_feat_pre.enc.pt via --encoder-weights); wbwq's own scope, warm-starting the 36 recipe skeletons, stays open. Ledger: experiments/README.md (2026-09-01).

title: swin_calib_dense's seat step names seat_value, which does not exist — the pricing tool is member_curve --paired
description:
experiments/arms/swin_calib_dense.sh pre-registers its verification as:

  seat  `seat_value --candidates swin_calib_dense_s2026.pt --against greedyseat_v1`, card-free, after.

There is no kneemri/evaluation/seat_value.py. `python -m kneemri.evaluation.seat_value --help` answers `No module named kneemri.evaluation.seat_value`. The module list holds member_curve, seat_bonus and pool, and none is named that.

WHY IT MATTERS AND WHY NOW. This is the faulty-PLUMBING case: a value written in an arm header while no consumer exists. It fails at the worst possible instant — the arm is a ~3 h card job, and the step is the one that reads its result, so the discovery would land after the card is spent and while a slot decision is waiting on it.

THE REPLACEMENT. `kneemri.evaluation.member_curve --checkpoints <candidate> <roster...> --labels <table> --paired` is the tool that prices a member's delta against a roster with a per-label 95% interval, which is what the header's --candidates/--against was reaching for. It is NOT card-free if the holdout npz for the candidate is absent: it runs inference. swin_calib_dense_s2026.holdout.npz already exists on disk, so for THIS arm it should be, but the header's 'card-free' claim is a property of the cache, not of the tool.

FIX: correct the header on the running arm's source copy is pointless (it is snapshotted); correct experiments/arms/swin_calib_dense.sh, and sweep the other arm headers for further tool names with no module behind them — arm_check does not check that a header's named tool resolves, which is the general form of this defect.
notes:
WITHDRAWN — MY ERROR, not a defect. seat_value is kneemri/kaggle/seat_value.py; I looked only in kneemri/evaluation/ because the arm header frames the step as card-free evaluation, and read 'No module named kneemri.evaluation.seat_value' as 'no such tool'.

The sweep the bead asked for was then run properly and is the only thing worth keeping from it. Every tool name INVOKED with flags in an arm header resolves to a module:

  build_merged · record_mix · run_comparison · seat_value · supervision_gap

and all 25 dotted kneemri.*/core.* module paths across experiments/arms/*.sh import cleanly. So there is no unresolvable-tool class of defect in the arm headers, and arm_check does not need a rule for one.

The correct invocation for knee-csxq's seat step is `python -m kneemri.kaggle.seat_value --candidates swin_calib_dense_s2026.pt --against greedyseat_v1`. The header is right as written.

title: arm_check must refuse --labels without --eval-labels: the ruler moves with the arm
description:
recal_holdannot passed --labels report_labels_v3.csv and left --eval-labels unset, so its holdout truth was binarised at 0.5 against the RE-MAPPED values. Its log ends 'best holdout mean AUC 0.8964' against a control of 0.8487 - a +0.0477 that is not a result at all, it is two different rulers. The matched proxy is +0.0009.

run_comparison DOES catch it at read time ('the two runs were scored by different label tables over their 909 shared studies'), and ruler_check gives the matched re-score. But nothing catches it BEFORE the card is spent, and the wrong number sits in the training log looking like the largest single-arm gain the project has ever measured. blendlabels got this right on 2026-08-25 by pinning --eval-labels; holdannot's clone did not.

FIX: arm_check refuses an arm whose command passes --labels with a table that is not the default AND does not pass --eval-labels. One rule, in the place that already reads every arm's recipe before it is queued. An arm that genuinely wants the ruler to move says so with an explicit --eval-labels pointing at the same table.
notes: Landed as arm_check's MOVING-RULER verdict (refuses on any run, like REFUSED/CRLF). It does not guess from the filename: ArmCheck.moved_cells reads both tables and counts holdout cells that cross ASSERTS_PRESENCE or change presence over the shared studies, silent when the gitignored tables are absent (CI). First sweep over 170 arms named three and cleared one that the filename rule had wrongly flagged: confident224 and confident_span (confident.csv, 14445 cells change presence) and recal_holdannot (report_labels_v3.csv, 6461 cells cross 0.5) — each count matching a number the repo had already written down elsewhere. merged_corpus is CLEAN: merged_labels.csv is a column union whose rows are byte-identical to v2, 0 cells moved, so its 0.8545 roster number and its per-finding deficit/surplus split stand. confident224 was already declined for this; confident_span is unarmed and unrecorded, so the check caught it before it cost a number.

title: witness_check --device cpu gives FALSE REFUSALS on large trunks; CLAUDE.md prescribes exactly that
description:
MEASURED 2026-08-30. The same member, the same package, the same batch, minutes apart:

  cpu   vjepa_warm_s2026: REFUSED - max|diff| 0.0456 > 0.0312, batch 6, 3 of 12 labels carry it
  cuda  vjepa_warm_s2026: ok      - max|diff| 0.0209 of 0.0312, batch 6, 7 of 12 labels carry it

The witness was recorded during TRAINING, which ran on CUDA. Replaying it on CPU changes the arithmetic
(different kernels, different accumulation order, different fused paths), and on a V-JEPA2 ViT-L - the
largest trunk the project owns - that drift alone is 0.0456, half again over the tolerance. Twenty-eight
smaller members passed on cpu in the same run, which is why this has not been seen before: the drift
scales with the trunk and the tolerance does not.

WHY IT MATTERS RATHER THAN BEING A CURIOSITY. The conventions list in CLAUDE.md says to run
witness_check.py --device cpu before a submission. Followed literally today it would have blocked a sound
entry (kneemri-vjepaseat) on a defect that does not exist, and the natural next move - declining the
member - would have cost the only non-DINO seat the project can currently ship. The check is a gate, so a
false refusal is as expensive as a false pass in the other direction.

ALSO NOTE THE LABEL COUNT MOVES: 3 of 12 labels carry the difference on cpu against 7 of 12 on cuda. A
refusal that names FEWER labels than the passing run is the signature of one label blowing out rather than
the reading being wrong everywhere, which is another reason to read a cpu refusal as arithmetic.

THE FIX IS ONE OF THREE, and the choice is a real one:
  (a) default --device auto to cuda when a card is visible, and say so in CLAUDE.md;
  (b) keep cpu as the default but widen the tolerance per trunk size, which weakens the check where it is
      strongest;
  (c) record the witness on the device it will be replayed on.
(a) is the cheapest and loses nothing: the member is SERVED on cuda on Kaggle, so cuda is the honest
replay. cpu remains useful only when no card is free, and then a refusal must be re-read on cuda before it
is believed - which is the rule this bead asks to be written down either way.

Until it is fixed: a cpu REFUSAL is not a verdict. Re-run the refused members with
--device cuda --members NAME before declining anything. See knee-40uw, which this answers.
notes:
FIXED 2026-08-30. The code was already right: --device auto resolves to cuda when a card is visible
(witness_check.py line 199/220-223). The defect was the CONVENTION -- CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md both
prescribed --device cpu, which is the invocation that refused vjepa_warm_s2026 at 0.0456 against a
0.0312 bound hours before the vjepaseat_v1 slot. The same member on cuda reads 0.0209.

The mechanism, and why the bound stays where it is: on cpu autocast is off, so a half-precision
witness is compared against a float32 re-derivation, and that precision gap ACCUMULATES over
transformer blocks. Every member in the 2026-08-13 calibration was a twelve-block ViT-S/ViT-B and
landed at 1.6-2.4x eps. vjepa_warm is a V-JEPA2 ViT-L, roughly three times the depth, and lands at
5.8x. So the band was fitted on shallow members and does not extrapolate. Widening it was the wrong
fix -- the 4x eps bound is the only thing separating this residual from the 0.05-0.5 that all four
real reading defects produced, and those also concentrate in a few labels where this one moved all
twelve about equally.

Changed: CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md now say --device auto and carry the numbers; the EPS_FACTOR docstring
records the third measurement and states the asymmetry -- a cpu refusal on a deep trunk is not
evidence of a reading defect (check cuda first), a cuda refusal still is.

title: Which Swin gets swinseat_v1's seventh seat — rule written before the curve finishes
description:
swinseat_v1 (knee-o1eg) seats ONE non-DINO member beside raptorweight_v1's six. Two Swin-base-384 checkpoints are candidates and the choice must be made on a rule stated BEFORE swin_wholetop's curve finishes, because it finishes in ~45 min and a rule written after the number is a fit to it.

CANDIDATES.
  swin_supervised_s2026  0.8331 solo (converged, peak e6). Stage 3 FROZEN for the whole run - the knee-94ec
    discovery defect. Nearest-neighbour agreement 0.8346, the most decorrelated member the project owns.
    Currently in comp/members.declines on a seat value of -0.0012 measured over the FOLD-0 pool.
  swin_wholetop_s2026    same recipe byte-identical on the fixed discovery, stage 3 open at 1e-4. At e9 of 12:
    peak 0.8274 (e6), then 0.8228 / 0.8223 / 0.8197. Declining. Only the one_cycle anneal is left.

THE RULE.
  Seat swin_wholetop IF its finished peak is 0.8331 or above - i.e. the fixed-discovery run is at least as
  good solo as the handicapped one. Otherwise seat swin_supervised.

WHY THAT RULE AND NOT A CORRELATION MEASUREMENT. The champion six are all --fold -1 and carry no holdout
records, so NO correlation between a Swin and the shipped roster can be computed. Every such number would
come off the fold-0 pool, which comp/champion.json names as producing a confident wrong answer about this
pin (a measured fourteen-tick miss on peak8_v1). So the tie-break has to be mechanism plus solo score, and
solo score is the only one of the two that is measured on the same ruler for both candidates.

THE MECHANISM, which points the same way. A frozen stage 3 keeps ImageNet-22k features at the top of the
network, untouched by this corpus. Fine-tuning that top pulls the trunk toward the corpus and therefore
toward whatever the six dinov2-small members already learned from it. So the handicapped run is expected to
be the MORE foreign of the two, which is the property the entry is buying, and it also scores higher. Both
axes agree, which is why the rule reduces to the solo number.

WHAT THIS DOES NOT CLAIM. It does not say the frozen top is a better design - it is a defect. It says a
characterised defect can be a legitimate instrument, which is the precedent champion.json states twice
(base_dense lost its own matched control by 0.0066 and bought a board tick; a different encoder is worth a
seat its own control says it lost).

ONE SEAT, NOT TWO. Seating both Swins would put ~17% of the blend on the non-DINO side instead of ~9.5%,
which would make the board read more likely to resolve. It is refused anyway: the two are near-twins of one
trunk on one recipe differing in one flag, so two seats is the same direction at double weight and not
diversity, and it would move the entry two steps from the pin instead of one. The FLAT band of swinseat_v1s
pre-registration already absorbs the case where 9.5% is too little to resolve.

title: vjepaseat_v1: seat our most distant non-DINO trunk on the champion, the axis its pin names as the plateau
description:
RETARGETED 2026-08-30, and the entry is now kneemri-vjepaseat rather than kneemri-swinseat.

WHY. swin_wholetop_s2026 finished 12 of 12 epochs, CONVERGED, peak 0.8274 at e6 - 0.0057 BELOW the
handicapped swin_supervised run it was built to correct, and 0.0186 below the 0.8460 merit level. The seat
rule pre-registered in knee-wqfz said: seat swin_wholetop if its peak reaches 0.8331, else seat
swin_supervised. It missed, and then a better member overtook both.

vjepa_warm_s2026 is ahead of both Swins on every axis measured on a shared ruler: 0.8337 solo against
0.8331 and 0.8274, and nearest-neighbour agreement 0.8119 against 0.8346 - the most decorrelated member
this project has ever produced, against a pool that agrees at 0.91-0.94. It is ALREADY on the roster,
already packaged in dimiturnt/kneemri-members and already mounted from dimiturnt/vjepa2-hf, so the entry
costs no 7.5 GB re-upload and the slot is spent hours earlier.

THE ENTRY. raptorweight_v1's exact six, the same raptor foreign seat at 1/3, the same LogitAverage, the
same kit at c1abf4c - plus vjepa_warm_s2026 as a SEVENTH member of ours. One variable moves.

WHAT WAS VERIFIED BEFORE THE SLOT. build_kernels --check EXIT 0. mount_check: ok, declares all of
dimiturnt/vjepa2-hf/vjepa2-vitl and metaresearch/dinov2/PyTorch/small/1, 0 refused of 73. kit_check
--mounted: dimiturnt/kneemri-kit at c1abf4c, 0 commits behind in the 38 files the kernel loads.
champion_check: EXIT 0. roster_check: 0 undocumented. convergence_check on swin_wholetop: converged.
witness_check on vjepa_warm: REFUSED on cpu at 0.0456, ok on CUDA at 0.0209 of 0.0312 - device drift, not
a reading defect; see knee-j99t and knee-40uw.

PRE-REGISTERED BANDS against the champion's 0.944, at the board's own 0.001 quantisation:
  0.946 or above  MOVES - architecture diversity from our own side is a real lever, two ticks clear of
                  board resolution, and it lands in the top ten. Follow-up is a SECOND non-DINO seat.
  0.943 to 0.945  FLAT - and at 9.5% of the blend (one seat of seven of ours, ours being 2/3) that is what
                  a proportional effect predicts against the raptor seat's 33% buying one tick. It does
                  NOT close the axis; the follow-up that would is the same entry with the share raised.
  0.942 or below  COSTS - read WITH fleettwo_v1's flat count reading before concluding anything about the
                  axis, since a cost here is as consistent with seat count as with architecture.

THE GOAL THIS DOES AND DOES NOT DISCHARGE. The goal was to train a non-DINO trunk and spend a submission
on it. The training half ran and did not produce a seatable member. Shipping swin_wholetop anyway would be
spending the slot on the checkpoint's provenance rather than on the axis, so the slot goes to the strongest
non-DINO member the project owns and the training half continues in swin_calib_dense (knee-csxq).

BUDGET RISK, stated because it is the one failure that would score this entry without the thing it is for:
V-JEPA2 ViT-L is the largest trunk in any entry shipped here. If the session runs short KernelRun drops
members. READ THE LOG'S MEMBER LIST before reading the score.

title: swin_calib_dense: read the non-DINO trunk on the recipe that actually seats members
description:
Every member seated on the champion roster carries --calibrated-targets; neither non-DINO trunk does, and swin_supervised additionally ran at 1e-4 against the seated 4e-5. So 'this architecture cannot seat' is unearned — the lane has never been read on the recipe that produces seatable members.

The calibration term is expected to transfer on a CORNER argument, not a hope: band_dense_hold + --calibrated-targets = calib_dense_hold measured +0.0061 and produced the best offline member this project owns (0.8634), while the same flag measured -0.0020 at the span corner. Its sign is a property of the operating point. calib_dense_hold ran --slices 20 --band-low 0.1 --band-high 0.9 --whole-stack; swin_supervised runs the same four. Dense corner, where it pays.

--hold-annotations is not a quality lever and is not here as one: it is knee-9198's standing rule that a label-side arm reports both rulers, and the gold one refuses checkpoints trained without it. This is NOT the roster retrain that bead forbids.

TWO FLAGS MOVE so this cannot attribute, and that is deliberate: the open question is whether a non-DINO trunk can seat at all, and splitting it costs 6 h to re-measure a half already measured at a matched corner.

PRICE: ~3 h card. P(clears the 0.8460 roster merit level) ~ 0.35 — 0.8331 + a transferred 0.0061 lands 0.8392, so the rate correction has to carry the rest. Better ratio than swin_toprate, which moves the rate alone on the base recipe and was repriced to well under 0.3.

BLOCKED on swin_wholetop's finished peak (knee-tsiz), same reason swin_toprate is: a rate arm read against a partial curve is fitted to it. Branches pre-registered in experiments/arms/swin_calib_dense.sh against the ROSTER (0.8460), not against the control.
notes:
SEATS BRANCH IS GATED ON vjepaseat_v1 (ref 55895006, pending as of 2026-08-30 17:12 UTC), and this is a constraint the arm header does not carry.

The header says: on a positive seat reading, mount, build an entry and spend a slot. knee-uco3 says why that is not yet enough. The seat bonus SATURATES at six or seven members whatever sits in them (dark6 0.937 = dark7 0.937; final_ws_cf n=6 +0.018, n=7 +0.020, n=8 +0.019, n=11 +0.018). So a swin entry is a seat SWAP, and three slots have already been spent measuring swap coordinates that were worth nothing.

The one thing that would re-open it is DIVERSITY paying where redundancy does not, and vjepaseat_v1 is that exact experiment already in flight: the first non-DINO non-raptor trunk to take a seat. Bands MOVES >=0.946 / FLAT 0.943-0.945 / COSTS <=0.942.

So: if vjepaseat reads FLAT or COSTS, a swin seat entry is a second reading of a coordinate just measured null, and the slot does not go to it on a SEATS branch alone -- swin's holdout number still stands as the answer to whether the lane was a recipe confound, which is what this arm was armed to learn. If vjepaseat MOVES, the non-DINO seat is live and a swin entry is priced against a real coordinate.

Trajectory at e3: 0.7992, needs +0.0468 for the 0.8460 SEATS floor against a corpus median gain of +0.0207 and p90 +0.0380. Not truncatable (generous ceiling 0.8521) but SEATS is above p90, so GAINS/FLAT is the likelier landing.

title: witness REFUSES vjepa_warm_s2026, the one member farseat_v1 shipped
description:
PRICE: 0 card-hours; the discriminating run is CPU-only and already launched. P(clears the bar) n/a - this is a RECORD defect, not a score arm; what it can change is whether farseat_v1's 0.937 is a reading of the distance axis or a reading of a broken member.

FACT. `python comp/witness_check.py --device cpu` over the full package on 2026-08-30 returned 53 ok, 8 unverified, 1 refused. The one refusal:

  [29/62] vjepa_warm_s2026: REFUSED - inference reads this member differently than training did (max|diff| 0.0456 > 0.0312, batch 6; 3 of 12 labels carry it)

WHY IT MATTERS. vjepa_warm_s2026 is on comp/members.roster (packaged, and remounted 2026-08-25 across seven kernels at the cost of a written-down kernel edit). comp/board.jsonl line 61 shows farseat_v1 (ref 55758082, board 0.937) seated it - so a scored entry served this member. It is NOT in comp/champion.json (raptorweight_v1 does not name it), so no pinned number moves.

THE EVIDENCE IS MIXED AND MUST NOT BE READ ONE WAY. The bound 0.0312 is 4*eps(bfloat16), so this is the loosest tolerance the check issues. 0.0456 is 5.8x eps against a MEASURED arithmetic band of 0.63-2.47x, which is over - but it is also well BELOW the 0.05-0.5 range every real reading defect this check exists for produced. The discriminator the check itself documents is CONCENTRATION, and that points the other way: 3 of 12 labels carry it, where a rounding residual touches every column about equally. So: magnitude says arithmetic, spread says defect.

THE NAMED CONFOUND, being measured. check() pads the witnessed studies up to the recorded batch by repeating the last one, and the docstring names half-precision GEMM tiling by shape as the leading candidate for the 0.0135-0.0156 five bf16 members already read. vjepa_warm is the one member in the inventory whose trunk is NOT a 2D image trunk: V-JEPA2-large tokenises two slices per token and is handed the stack. A sweep over --batch 6 / 8 / 12, with extended_ws_s2026 (bf16, passing) as the control, is running to logs/witness_batchsweep.log. A residual that MOVES with batch is tiling; one that is flat across all three is deterministic and the reading question stays open.

DO NOT unroster on this line alone. The member's roster entry is a long argument about distance and it is re-opened by answering it, not by a number of unknown cause.
notes: ANSWERED 2026-08-30. witness_check --device cuda --members vjepa_warm_s2026: ok, max|diff| 0.0209 of a 0.0312 tolerance over 8 studies, batch 6, 7 of 12 labels carrying it. The CPU run REFUSED the same member minutes earlier at 0.0456 with only 3 of 12 labels carrying it. So the refusal was DEVICE DRIFT and not a reading defect, and vjepa_warm's serving path reproduces its training reads on the device Kaggle actually runs (T4, CUDA). It is shippable.

title: swin_toprate: the top is open, so train it at a rate the top can take
description:
swin_wholetop opened Swin-B's two 1024-wide stage-3 blocks (37,869,696 trainable against the handicapped
run's 18,965,088) and did not merely fail to gain — it drifted away from the frozen-top control, monotone
since e1: +0.0003, +0.0013, -0.0001, -0.0028, -0.0041 through e4. Twice the capacity, and the extra
capacity is costing.

That is a RATE result, not a capacity result, and it is the mechanism swin_wholetop.sh pre-registered
under REFUTES before it ran. --layer-decay is the wrong tool for it: backbone_groups scales a group by
backbone_lr * layer_decay ** (len(opened) - 1 - depth), so the LAST opened block keeps the full rate and
decay only lowers the 512-wide stage-2 blocks that were already training fine at 1e-4.

The arm is swin_wholetop with one flag moved: --backbone-lr 3e-5 instead of 1e-4. Three points then
bracket the trunk's top — frozen (0.8331), open at 1e-4 (swin_wholetop's peak), open at 3e-5 — and only
the third could let the extra capacity pay. 3e-5 is not a fresh guess: 4e-5 is the ViT adapter rate this
harness used everywhere before 1e-4 was picked for a frozen-top Swin that never trained its widest blocks.

PRICE: 3.0 h of card (12 epochs at swin_wholetop's measured 894-923 s after the first; identical memory,
the same blocks train and only their rate changes). P(clears SEAT 0.8393) ~ 0.30. P(clears the 0.8460
merit level) ~ 0.15. P(clears LANDS 0.8560) ~ 0.05. The trunk has been read at two settings of its top
and neither cleared 0.8393, so the most likely outcome is that 3e-5 recovers roughly the frozen-top
number rather than beating it, which is COSTS.

WHY IT IS STILL WORTH THE CARD is an INSTRUMENT argument rather than an improvement one. On the COSTS
branch it retires an entire axis in one run: it says swin_supervised's 0.8331 was not a handicap but the
right amount of trunk to move, which kills the knee-uk4f ConvNeXt re-open (the same correction on the
same flag, ~4 h) without spending that card, and it closes the supervised-trunk family for seating on
three measured points rather than one. The expected saving on that branch alone is comparable to its own
cost, and the 0.30 chance of a seat is on top of it.

BRANCHES, against 0.8331 and the 0.0062 floor: LANDS >=0.8560 / SEAT 0.8393-0.8559 / COSTS 0.8269-0.8392
(the ConvNeXt re-open dies with it) / REFUTES <0.8269 (the deficit is not in the rate; move the recipe,
not the optimiser).

WHAT WOULD MAKE IT NOT WORTH RUNNING: swin_wholetop finishing at or above 0.8393. Then the capacity DID
pay, the rate story is refuted by its own arm, and the card goes to packaging a member instead.

BLOCKED ON swin_wholetop's finished peak. A rate arm fitted to a curve read at e4 is fitting the
follow-up to a partial run. Script written and arm_check-clean at experiments/arms/swin_toprate.sh;
not queued.
notes:
REPRICED 2026-08-30T14:14Z, card-free, and the arm's own seat bar is now the thing in question rather than
its odds of reaching it.

THE MEASUREMENT. `seat_value --candidates vjepa_warm_s2026.pt swin_supervised_s2026.pt --against
greedyseat_v1`, both of the project's best non-DINO trunks on ONE ruler against the same 7-member champion
roster (0.8763):

  +vjepa_warm_s2026      0.8756  (-0.0007)  [-0.0016, +0.0002]   nearest 0.8119  mean 0.8012
  +swin_supervised_s2026 0.8751  (-0.0012)  [-0.0020, -0.0003]   nearest 0.8346  mean 0.8132

VJEPA_WARM NEVER SEATED ON MERIT. It is on the roster on a distance ARGUMENT - the most distant member the
project has ever produced - and priced against the champion roster it is NEGATIVE, same as the swin member
that was declined. Its band includes zero so it is unreadable rather than convicted, but it is nowhere near
the +0.0015 under which this ruler has never picked a board tick.

AND THE FAVOURABLE TEST IS THE ONE THAT FAILED. vjepa is the MORE distant of the two by a wide margin
(nearest 0.8119 against swin's 0.8346, mean 0.8012 against 0.8132) and scores 0.0006 HIGHER solo, and it
still prices no better in any way that clears the floor. So "maximal diversity pays for a solo deficit"
has now been tested twice at ~0.833, the second time under the conditions most favourable to it, and
failed twice. Distance is not the missing ingredient at this solo level - it is already maxed out and it
is not enough.

WHAT THIS DOES TO THIS ARM. swin_toprate's SEAT branch is 0.8393-0.8559, set as "a real gain over the
frozen-top control". That bar was derived from the CONTROL, not from the roster, and the measurement above
says the roster will not seat a non-DINO member at 0.8393 either: 0.8337 at maximum distance reads -0.0007,
and closing +0.0022 to reach the ruler's own +0.0015 threshold has to come from solo quality now that
distance is spent. The roster's merit level is 0.8460 and every seated member is above it. So the arm's
real seat bar is ~0.846+, not 0.8393, and this family's best-ever read is the control's 0.8331.

NO SLOPE IS FITTED HERE and the two points are not extrapolated - the standing lesson is that only the SIGN
transfers, and the third point has broken an ordering before. The claim is only the sign, twice, at maximum
distance.

REPRICE. Was: ~3 h card, P(clears SEAT 0.8393) ~ 0.3. Now: ~3 h card, P(clears a seat that the roster would
actually take, ~0.846) well under 0.3, from a family whose ceiling is 0.8331. That is a worse ratio than it
was written with, and the arm is NOT queued on the old number. It stays blocked on swin_wholetop's peak,
and if the knee-tsiz tie-break reads REFUTES the licence it grants must be re-argued against THIS bar, not
against 0.8393.

WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY, because a decline is an argument and this one has limits. It does not say the
non-DINO lane is dead - it says the lane does not seat by DISTANCE at ~0.833, which is a fact about the
level, not the architecture. A non-DINO trunk that reads 0.85+ solo has never been tried and is not
addressed by this at all. It also does not unroster vjepa_warm: an unreadable band is not a conviction, and
that member's line is answered by a number, not by this one.

title: Pre-registered fallback for the free slot if swin_wholetop misses its LANDS branch
description:
DECIDED 2026-08-30T12:40Z, before the number, so it is not decided under time pressure at 16:20.

kneemri-swinseat ships ONLY on the arm's LANDS branch (solo 0.8560 or above). Its own docstring says why: 'the entry is built only on the arm's LANDS branch, so it is not made out of a member the deficit argument already covers.' If swin_wholetop reads SEAT (0.8393-0.8559), COSTS or REFUTES, no entry is built from it.

THE FALLBACK IS TO HOLD THE SLOT, and the record licenses no alternative:
- Another reseating is barred three times over - knee-xuj5 (slots do not go to seat permutations), knee-uco3 (the seventh seat is INERT, dark6 reads 0.937), knee-va22 (ensemble axis saturated across 16 board entries).
- The board makes it visual: fourteen scored all-ours ensemble entries span 0.937-0.944, spanning 3 to 11 members. That range is the monoculture, not a search.
- champion.json names two remaining routes, external data and stacking. Stacking is NOT untried: votefit_v1 fitted vote weights over the same six members calibsix_v1 averages plainly, and read 0.938 against calibsix's 0.941. Fitted weights LOST to the average on this pool, so a stacking entry is not a licensed spend of a slot - it is a re-run of a measurement we have.
- External data is knee-ombx, blocked on the owner, and MRNet is probably barred (knee-2sbk).

So on any branch but LANDS: spend nothing, and the day ends with slots unspent. That is the correct outcome, not a failure - a slot spent to avoid leaving one unspent is the waste the pacing direction names. The next spend then waits on a member that clears the merit level, and the arm queue behind swin_wholetop (recal_holdannot) is where that comes from.

Re-open this only by naming a member or a mechanism, never by naming a spare slot.

title: Recalibrate the reader's levels onto the empirical gold rate — six numbers, one arm
description:
THE DEFECT, measured on 696 cells (58 gold studies x 12 findings) under knee-7oep.

The report reader emits six confidence levels. Against the radiologist rows they map to:

  0.08 -> 0.041 (n=196)   0.28 -> 0.136 (n=177)   0.50 -> 0.417 (n=12)
  0.68 -> 0.378 (n=98)    0.82 -> 0.688 (n=141)   0.94 -> 0.958 (n=72)

The ends are nearly right; the MIDDLE is not. The 0.68 bucket is 98 cells that are 62% negative,
trained today as 0.68 positive - a target wrong by about 0.30 on 14% of all cells, always in the
direction that invents positives. Mean per-finding rank AUC is 0.866 while binarised agreement at 0.5
is 0.789, so the ORDERING is already good and the VALUE is what is broken. That is exactly the defect
a monotone re-map fixes and a better reader does not.

THE ARM. Write labels/report_labels_v3.csv by replacing each level with its empirical rate above,
pooled across findings (six parameters on 696 cells; a per-finding fit at n=58 would be fitting noise).
The 0.50 bucket has twelve cells and is not separately estimable - fold it into the monotone fit rather
than reading 0.417 off it. Then run ONE arm at the control recipe with --labels pointing at v3.

SIZE. knee-m69u measured +0.0034 from a mere label-TABLE swap between tables that binarise identically -
a pure training effect. This changes the target VALUES on 14% of cells rather than swapping files, so
the mechanism is the same one and strictly larger. Cost is a CPU relabel plus one arm at the control
recipe (~40 min). Ratio is the best on the board: the seating axis is closed from the price side and
top-10 costs +0.0042.

THE RULER ASYMMETRY, pre-registered before anything is armed. Our offline holdout truth IS the
report-derived table, so aligning training with the image-read process can LOWER the offline number
while raising the board. Read this arm on gold AUC FIRST (foreign_gate --gold-auc, n=58, weak but
pointed at the right process) and on holdout second. A holdout regression inside the 0.0062 floor is
NOT a refutation here; a gold-AUC regression is.

blocks on: nothing. depends on knee-7oep for the measurement.
PRICE: ~50 min of card — one run at the v3base_dense recipe. The relabel was CPU and is already done.

The gain the mechanism could plausibly deliver is +0.003 to +0.010 on the axis it is read on. knee-m69u
measured +0.0034 from a label-TABLE swap between tables that binarise IDENTICALLY, which can only be a
training effect; this moves 12.2% of cells (6,461 of 52,872) across the 0.5 boundary and shifts every
remaining target, so it is the same mechanism strictly larger.

P(clears the 0.0062 paired floor on GOLD AUC) ~ 0.5. P(clears it on HOLDOUT) is deliberately lower, and
that is the design rather than a weakness: the offline holdout truth IS the report-derived table, so the
predicted shape is gold AUC up and holdout flat-to-slightly-down. A holdout regression inside the floor
is not a refutation here; a gold-AUC regression is.

Ratio against what else is open: fifty minutes for a shot at the only unmapped axis of the right size,
against a seating axis closed from the price side (every arrangement of members we own is already behind
the champion) and knobs priced at +0.0002 to +0.0035. Top-10 costs +0.0042 offline and nothing else on
the board is priced to pay it.
notes: RESULT 2026-08-30: LANDS branch. GOLD 0.9037 vs holdannot 0.8932 = +0.0105 (above the 0.0062 floor). Matched proxy via ruler_check on report_labels_v2: 0.8515 vs 0.8506 = +0.0009, i.e. free. Confident-only ruler +0.0014. The training log's 0.8964 is NOT the proxy - the arm left --eval-labels unset so its holdout truth was v3-binarised and the ruler moved with the arm; run_comparison correctly refused the pair. Ledger section written. Follow-ups: v3 becomes the default label table for label-side arms; a dense-corner replication before any roster rebuild.

title: Field consensus (forum, 2026-08-30): the ceiling is LABEL MAKING, and the test labels were made from IMAGES not reports
description:
Read card-free from the competition forum, thread 735826 ('What is the real bottleneck now: labels, image pipeline, or model capacity?', 11 replies) plus 737650 and the gold-set remarks in 736170. No slot, no card. GATHER step, not a claim of ours.

WHAT THE FIELD SAYS, with the mechanism rather than the vote:
- Single DINO members reach 0.91-0.92; increasing encoder size does NOT improve CV. One participant froze
  a (4407, 6, 9, 224, 224) uint8 cache and label pipeline as a control, swapped ResNet34 -> DINOv2-Small
  with diagnosis-specific slot attention, and got WORSE OOF BCE (0.664 -> 0.674). Capacity is not the lever.
  This is a foreign replication of our own architecture-distance reading (knee-y59c) from the other side.
- The decisive claim, repeated by three separate people: 'the entire competition is the label making', and
  per a host comment the people who made the TEST labels did not start from the reports at all - they read
  IMAGES. So our supervision and the target are two different generating processes, not a noisy copy of one.
- The failure is concentrated at the SEVERITY BOUNDARY. Reports with a small-size qualifier ('small',
  'minimal', 'trace', and the non-English equivalents) carry BOTH Effusion=0 and Effusion=1; two reports
  using the SAME English template and the SAME sentence got opposite labels. At least one 'moderate
  effusion' report is labelled 0, so it is not a threshold at all. An LLM reader's CONFIDENCE is therefore
  confidence in APPLYING A HEURISTIC TO WORDS, and is high exactly where the underlying image judgement is
  most uncertain - the certainty and the severity point opposite ways at the boundary.

WHY THIS IS NOT ALREADY IN OUR LEDGER. knee-fuhq measures the shared supervision ceiling from the inside
(supervision_gap: labels - model = -0.0498, the model beating its own labels on ten of twelve findings) and
knee-m69u prices the label-TABLE swap at +0.0034. Both take the report as the source and ask how to read it
better. The forum reading says the source itself is the wrong process, which is a different lever and one
this project has not priced. ordinal_signal already asks the adjacent question (do graded YES levels carry
severity or only certainty) - its answer is the input this needs.

WHAT WOULD MAKE IT AN AXIS RATHER THAN A THREAD SUMMARY, cheapest first:
1. Per-finding agreement between our table and the 58 gold rows, read as a DIAGNOSTIC not a fit (n=58 is
   far too few to refit twelve thresholds). Names which finding's rule is furthest off, with a size.
2. Restrict to the boundary set - studies whose report carries a small-size qualifier - and measure our
   table's agreement with gold THERE against everywhere else. If the whole disagreement lives at the
   boundary, the target is a soft/ordinal supervision at the boundary rather than a better reader.
3. Only then price a supervision arm. It clears the 'plausibly 1.5%' bar in a way no remaining knob does,
   which is the bar knee-m69u asks a new axis to meet.

STATED LIMIT: this is what participants SAY, on a public forum, mid-competition. It is a hypothesis to
test on our own data, and step 1 is the test. It is filed as a P1 because knee-m69u asked for a named new
axis and this is the only candidate of the right size that is not blocked on an owner download (knee-ombx).
notes:
MEASURED 2026-08-30 11:14Z, card-free, no slot. Step 1 and step 2 of the plan above are DONE and the axis survives.

DENOMINATOR: 58 gold studies x 12 findings = 696 cells. Every rate below is over that, not over the corpus.
Table read: labels/report_labels_v2.csv, the one experiments/lib.sh gives every arm. GoldRows.reported
